scripts.build: bun run build:metadata && bun run --workspaces --if-present build && bun run build:tarball:optional
scripts.generate:api-types: bun run build:metadata && bun run --filter i18n --filter misskey-reversi --filter backend build && bun run --filter backend generate-api-json --no-build && cp packages/backend/built/api.json packages/misskey-js/generator/api.json && bun run --filter misskey-js update-autogen-code && bun run --filter misskey-js build && bun run --filter misskey-js api
scripts.start: cd packages/backend && bun run compile-config && bun ./built/entry.js
scripts.start:inspect: cd packages/backend && bun run compile-config && bun --inspect ./built/entry.js
scripts.start:test: cp ./.github/misskey/test.yml ./.config/test.yml && cd packages/backend && NODE_ENV=test bun run compile-config && NODE_ENV=test bun ./built/entry.js
scripts.start:with-migrations: bun run migrate && bun run start
scripts.lint: bun run --sequential --no-exit-on-error --workspaces --if-present lint && bun run check:declarations
scripts.test:e2e: bun run start-server-and-test start:test http://localhost:61812 "bun run --filter frontend test:e2e"
scripts.test:e2e-devcontainer: cp ./.config/playwright-devcontainer.yml ./.config/test.yml && bun run start-server-and-test start:test http://localhost:61812 "bun run --filter frontend test:e2e"
scripts.test: bun run build:metadata && bun run --filter i18n --filter misskey-reversi --filter misskey-js build && bun run --workspaces --if-present test
scripts.test:scripts: bun test scripts/checks/declarations.test.mjs scripts/checks/vue-typecheck.test.mjs scripts/benchmarks/backend/runner.test.ts scripts/benchmarks/storage/run.test.mjs scripts/dev/docker.test.mjs scripts/dev/docker.integration.test.mjs --timeout 60000
